problem_name: Persistent yield gap and stagnant paddy productivity
problem_definition: National average paddy yields have stayed between about 2.4 and 3.1 t/ha since 2000, far below neighbours and below simulated attainable yields.
immediate_causes: Sub-optimal nutrient rates and timing; Low use of quality seed; Poor water control and stress-prone environments (flood, drought, salinity); Shift to broadcast direct seeding under labor scarcity
root_causes: Weak public investment in research and extension; Conflict and macro-policy shocks since 2021; Low and volatile farm profitability
geographic_scope: National; largest absolute gaps in Delta and Coastal zones; Kayah and Chin lowest yields (conflict).
farmers_affected: Most rice farmers nationally (MAPS samples 2,700-3,100 producers per monsoon round represent all states/regions).
yield_impact: Gap to attainable yield is multiple t/ha in favourable areas (S114, S189).
financial_impact: Lower yields combined with rising costs drove 2025 profits to a six-year low (S302).
data_availability: National series (D01, D02) and plot-level panel yields (D04) are available; official subnational yields not public after 2020 (S251).
data_science_potential: Yield-gap decomposition, efficiency analysis, and targeting of yield constraints by agro-ecological zone using MAPS panel.

problem_name: Cost-price squeeze: rising input costs, falling farm profitability
problem_definition: Input, labour and mechanization costs have risen much faster than farmgate paddy prices, pushing paddy profits to multi-year lows.
symptom: Falling profit per acre; reduced input use
immediate_causes: Higher wages, mechanization fees, fertilizer and fuel prices; Lower farmgate paddy prices tracking world prices
root_causes: Dual exchange-rate regime and import restrictions; Conflict-related transport and market disruption; Global fuel and fertilizer shocks
geographic_scope: National; insecure areas face higher input costs (+1-6%).
farmers_affected: National paddy producers (MAPS: 2,734 producers in 2025 monsoon round).
data_availability: MAPS farm budgets each season (D04); monthly retail prices (D06, D24, D35); exchange-rate estimates (D36).
data_science_potential: Season-ahead profitability nowcasts, input-price pass-through models, price-aware input recommendations.

problem_name: Rural labour scarcity and rising agricultural wages
problem_definition: Out-migration and conflict have tightened rural labour markets, raising wages and changing how rice is established and harvested.
symptom: Higher wage bill; labour unavailable at peak operations
immediate_causes: Migration to cities and abroad; Insecurity limiting worker mobility
root_causes: Structural transformation since 2011; Post-2021 conflict and economic crisis
yield_impact: Indirect via broadcasting and delayed operations (S302).
financial_impact: Wage bill is the fastest-rising cost (S302).
data_availability: Wages in MAPS (D04); migration in MHWS and Migration Assessment (D05, D30); wage measurement bias studied (S297).
data_science_potential: Township wage nowcasting, labour-saving technology targeting, panel analysis of migration and mechanization.

problem_name: Fertilizer cost, access and declining use efficiency
problem_definition: Fertilizer is farmers' most important commercial input; conflict and FX distortions raised prices, cut use and lowered yield response per unit of nitrogen.
symptom: Lower or mistimed fertilizer use; weak yield response
immediate_causes: High urea prices relative to paddy; Reduced access to extension and optimal blends; Poor timing vs recommendations
root_causes: FX and import licensing restrictions; Conflict; Absence of site- and price-specific recommendations
geographic_scope: National; highest prices in remote/conflict areas.
data_availability: Plot-level fertilizer quantities, prices and yields in MAPS (D04); soil data coarse (D17); no public nutrient-omission trial database identified.
data_science_potential: Economic-optimum N by zone and price ratio; yield-response estimation with panel controls; advisory delivery and A/B evaluation.

problem_name: Flood, cyclone and heavy-rain losses in Delta and coastal rice
problem_definition: Monsoon floods, heavy rain and cyclones repeatedly cut paddy yields in low-lying Delta and coastal townships.
symptom: Seasonal yield losses and crop failure
immediate_causes: Riverine and pluvial flooding; Cyclones and storm surge
root_causes: Low-lying delta topography; Climate variability and change; Limited drainage and early warning
geographic_scope: Ayeyarwady, Bago, Yangon, Rakhine, Mon, Tanintharyi
farmers_affected: 7-15% of paddy farmers per monsoon report flood/heavy rain shocks (S252, S302).
data_availability: Open SAR flood mapping (D09, D16, D26), rainfall (D13, D15), cyclone tracks (D21), farmer-reported shocks with township (D04).
data_science_potential: Township flood-exposure index, loss estimation, anticipatory targeting, index-insurance basis-risk analysis.

problem_name: Drought and rainfall variability in the Central Dry Zone
problem_definition: Erratic rainfall and dry spells limit rainfed and pump-irrigated rice in the semi-arid Central Dry Zone.
immediate_causes: Dry spells at critical stages; Water shortage for irrigation
root_causes: Semi-arid climate; Limited reliable irrigation; Climate change
data_availability: CHIRPS, IMERG, ERA5-Land, MODIS (open); MAPS shocks.
data_science_potential: Drought early warning (SPI/NDVI anomalies), seasonal planting advisories.

problem_definition: Dry-season saline intrusion prevents summer rice near the coast and depresses yields and variety choice.
symptom: No summer rice / low coastal yields
immediate_causes: Saline river water in dry season; Storm surge
root_causes: Sea-level and flow changes; Low elevation of delta lands
geographic_scope: Coastal Ayeyarwady (Labutta, Bogale, Pyapon, Mawlamyinegyun), Rakhine
trend: Likely worsening with sea-level rise (not quantified in corpus)
data_availability: Sentinel-2 open; in-situ EC measurements scarce (must be collected).
data_science_potential: Salinity mapping model operationalisation; dry-season planting-window advisory.

problem_name: Conflict and macro-policy shocks disrupting production and markets (post-2021)
problem_definition: Violence after the 2021 coup, plus FX controls, reduced productivity, technology use, credit and market access.
symptom: Lower productivity and market participation in insecure areas
immediate_causes: Reduced extension, inputs, credit and labour access; Transport disruption
root_causes: Armed conflict; Dual exchange rate and trade restrictions
geographic_scope: National; most severe in Sagaing, Kayah, Chin, Rakhine and parts of Magway/Mandalay (per sources).
financial_impact: Lower farmgate prices in conflict areas (S228)
data_availability: ACLED (D18) + MAPS (D04) panel; data collection in conflict zones has measurable but modest bias (S297).
data_science_potential: Conflict-aware targeting of input/advisory support; spatial econometrics.

problem_name: Weak and shock-sensitive access to quality seed
problem_definition: Farmers increasingly recycle own seed; off-farm quality seed access falls after weather and conflict shocks.
immediate_causes: Seed supply disruptions; Cost of purchased seed
root_causes: Thin early-generation seed (EGS) capacity; Conflict and weather shocks
geographic_scope: National; Delta and Dry Zone analysed
yield_impact: Positive yield association of off-farm seed (S299)
data_availability: MAPS seed source (D04); seed farm locations from secondary sources (S299) - not a public dataset.
data_science_potential: Seed-access gap mapping; location of seed multiplication.

problem_definition: Large irrigation schemes and pump schemes deliver less water and fewer dry-season crops than designed.
immediate_causes: Canal delivery shortfalls; Pump operating costs; Weak water-user organisation
geographic_scope: Dry Zone schemes and Delta polders
data_availability: Satellite VI and water (D12, D16); scheme records not public.
data_science_potential: Remote-sensing performance benchmarking of irrigation command areas.

problem_name: Harvest and post-harvest losses (drying, storage, rodents)
problem_definition: Traditional harvesting, field stacking, sun drying and storage cause quantity and quality losses.
immediate_causes: Delayed threshing and field stacking; Sun drying in wet season; Rodents in stores
data_availability: No national loss dataset; experimental data only.
data_science_potential: Dryer/mill location-allocation; loss-risk mapping using harvest-time rainfall.

problem_name: Mechanization service access and rising service costs
problem_definition: Rapid, market-driven mechanization through outsourcing is now threatened by fuel prices, conflict and rising fees.
symptom: Falling combine use; higher plowing fees
immediate_causes: Fuel cost and availability; Insecurity limiting service providers' movement
data_availability: MAPS mechanization use and fees; service-provider surveys (D32).
data_science_potential: Service coverage gaps mapping; fee monitoring; routing/scheduling of combine services.

problem_definition: Government and microfinance credit fell after 2021; farmers withdraw from credit markets and self-finance.
immediate_causes: Collapse of formal lending in conflict areas
data_availability: MAPS credit modules; MADB data not public.
data_science_potential: Limited - credit is a policy/institutional problem.

problem_name: Extension and information gap (research does not reach farmers)
problem_definition: Public extension weakened, and proven decision tools (e.g., Rice Crop Manager) did not scale; digital channels are emerging.
symptom: Farmers use generic or outdated practices
immediate_causes: Reduced extension contact; No site-specific advice
data_availability: Advisory-usage data held by platforms; MAPS extension module.
data_science_potential: Personalised advisory content, A/B testing, uptake analytics.

problem_name: Price distortions and weak price transmission (FX, export policy)
problem_definition: Exchange-rate controls and trade policy reduce farmgate incentives; domestic/export price links shift with policy.
symptom: Low farmgate prices relative to export parity
immediate_causes: Implicit export tax; Import cost of inputs
data_availability: Monthly prices (D06, D24, D35), exchange rates (D36), trade (D23).

problem_name: Agricultural statistics and monitoring data gaps
problem_definition: Official subnational production data are not publicly available after 2020, and key price and loss datasets have coverage holes.
symptom: Decisions made without current subnational evidence
immediate_causes: No public post-2020 subnational statistics; Price monitoring gaps in main rice regions
root_causes: Institutional disruption since 2021; Access constraints in conflict zones
trend: Partially filled by phone surveys (MAPS, MHWS) and satellites
data_availability: Open satellite archives; MAPS/MHWS phone panels.

problem_definition: Biotic stresses are the most frequently reported production shock.
immediate_causes: Weeds in direct-seeded fields; Rodent outbreaks after floods
data_availability: Farmer-reported shocks (D04); no pest surveillance data public.
data_science_potential: Image-based detection exists in prototypes (S279, S293); surveillance data are the binding constraint.

problem_name: Shift to broadcast direct seeding and its yield trade-off
problem_definition: Labour and water constraints push farmers to broadcast direct seeding, which farmers perceive as lower-yielding.
immediate_causes: Labour scarcity at transplanting; Water constraints
root_causes: Migration and wage rises; Lack of precision seeding services
data_availability: Establishment method, wages and yields in MAPS (D04).
data_science_potential: Establishment-method profitability model by zone and wage level; row/drum-seeder service targeting.

problem_definition: Continuous flooding and residue burning contribute GHG; mitigation evidence is experimental only.
